title: THE TURTLE RETURNS TO SEA BUT LEAVES A SECRET
caption: One turtle's journey ends where the next begins. 🐢🌊 #GreenSeaTurtle #Wildlife #OceanLife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: A green sea turtle heads back into the waves. What brought her onto land?
narration_timeline.scene: Open on verified adult green turtle returning to sea after nesting.

narration_timeline.text: She had just buried her eggs in a sandy nest above the tide.
narration_timeline.scene: Show real nesting beach and returning adult, no false egg-laying reenactment.

narration_timeline.text: Then she returned to the ocean, leaving those eggs to develop without her.
narration_timeline.scene: Show a real green sea turtle swimming away from the beach.

narration_timeline.text: The mother doesn't stay to protect them. The sand becomes their incubator.
narration_timeline.scene: Keep footage on real species while explaining eggs underground, not visually depicted.

narration_timeline.text: Weeks later, tiny hatchlings emerge and must cross the beach alone.
narration_timeline.scene: Show authentic hatchling release/young turtle context if supported by source.

narration_timeline.text: Her journey ends at sea, while the next generation's journey begins on shore.
narration_timeline.scene: End on documented wild green sea turtle hatchlings heading toward surf.
